verdict.rationale: Bolt documents creating and syncing a GitHub repository from a project, so the generated code lives outside Bolt and can be deployed elsewhere. The open-source repo claims 'Deploy to production from chat', and a community report mentions Bolt-deployed components on Netlify with the app launched on Vercel. The first-party hosting docs, however, only describe Bolt's own bolt.host hosting and custom domains. missing for 10: documented one-click or guided deployment to named external hosts (e.g. Netlify/Vercel), documented self-hosting or own-infrastructure deployment steps, independent hands-on confirmation of an external deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure
